capabilities: Search notes semantically via local vector embeddings
Fall back to BM25 keyword search when semantic search fails
Index and embed notes automatically in the background
Generate or force-rebuild embeddings from commands
Configure QMD binary path, file masks, and indexing intervals
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); no mobile support. Requires ~300MB disk for the embedding model, downloaded from HuggingFace on first use. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only matches keywords, so finding notes by meaning requires a tool that can compute vector embeddings over the vault.

relations.evidence: QMD by Tobi Lütke - The underlying search engine

requires.name: Internet connection for first-time model download from HuggingFace

summary: Semantic-first vault search powered by the local QMD CLI, with BM25 keyword fallback, automatic background indexing, and embedding generation.
